clauses.clause: When this creature enters, if you control two or more nonland, nontoken permanents with the same name as one another, create a 4/4 colorless Construct artifact creature token.
clauses.evidence: The standard board has no two permanents of one name, so the trace only shows the false case: [cast] and the opponent's-turn entry have no 'triggered ability triggers' event and no token (the intervening-if is read as the creature enters, CR 603.4), which agrees with the printed text. The true case and the token never appear. Tree abilities[0]: enters-event (ZoneChangeEvent to your battlefield, IS_SOURCE), condition QTY_GE(count = QDistinct(NAME over your nonland nontoken permanents) + 1, quantity = QCount of the same set) i.e. 'more permanents than names', effect CREATE_TOKEN 1 of a 4/4 Construct artifact creature (colorless: no colors). Packs on the live tree: I03_1 (two Twin Bear + Lone Wolf: exactly one 4/4 Construct), I03_2 (all names different: none), I03_3 (the opponent has a same-named pair, and one Solo Bear on each side: none), I03_4 (two tokens, two lands, one nontoken plus one token of a name: none), I03_5 (the entering Replicator counts: another permanent named Chrome Replicator: one token), I03_6 (a triple and a pair: still exactly one token). Control, not ownership: I03_7 (one Twin Bear yours plus one you gain control of: a token), I03_8 (two of yours, the opponent gains one: none).
